merge_rule: Union of gemm_flatten_v1 and flash_no_RMW overlay. On id conflicts, the no-RMW overlay replaces the v1 entry.

tiling.focus: Local staging, tiling, reuse, and load-compute-store. Keep compute off m_axi.

pipeline.focus: Pipeline the hot local loops, hit a legal II, and fix false or true recurrences.

unroll.focus: Unroll independent or reduction loops and match array partition to the factor.

coalescing.focus: Burst-friendly m_axi access, 512-bit widening, and matching lane-wide compute.

doublebuffer.focus: Overlap load and compute with ping-pong buffers or a canonical dataflow schedule.
